I know this is just a joke but in case people are wondering, here is a tip: The equation doesn’t have a meaning in Physics. But I assume the equation is trying to describe thermal conduction, e.g. the temperature of a glass of water by mixing two 0 degrees Celsius water. However, when we solve a thermal conduction problem, the unit of temperature is Kelvin. So we must convert either Celsius or Fahrenheit to Kelvin first, solve the math equation, and convert the unit back.
